output.text: {"notes":["The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; therefore the requested forward position and velocity are world-x quantities.","The requested readout time is absolute simulation time T = 2.0 s; position is in meters, velocity in meters per second, and stopped_by_T is boolean-valued with unit 1.","The scheduled intervention begins at 0.4905 s and remains active through 2.0 s; after onset, each axle uses zero-velocity braking with a maximum torque of 0.25 N·m.","stopped_by_T requires absolute forward speed below 0.02 m/s and planar speed below 0.03 m/s continuously for 0.2 s, with the qualifying interval ending by T."]}
